claims.statement: TimeSlotConfig models a slot as flat fields (id, name, startMinutes, endMinutes, tags, excludedTags defaulting to empty) with half-open [start, end) minutes-of-day semantics: endMinutes <= startMinutes means a cross-midnight slot covering [start, 24:00) ∪ [0, end), start == end is zero-length and illegal, and covers() normalizes minuteOfDay modulo 1440 before testing.

MoodSlotResolver.hitSlot selects the covering slot with covers() and minByOrNull(startMinutes), so valid (pairwise non-overlapping) configs hit at most one slot per minute and invalid multi-hit data resolves deterministically to the earliest-start slot; activeTags returns null when the switch is off, configs are empty, or no slot covers the minute, otherwise the hit slot's tag set.

MoodSlotResolver.validate rejects blank names, names over NAME_MAX_LENGTH (20), empty tags only when tags and excludedTags are both empty (NO_TAGS, so an exclude-only slot is legal), any word present in both sets (EXCLUDED_TAG_OVERLAP), and zero-length ranges as SlotValidation.Invalid, and returns Conflict naming the overlapping existing config while excluding the candidate's own id (same-id edits are not self-conflicts); overlap uses ring-timeline segment splitting where touching half-open endpoints do not overlap. Both TimeSlotConfigStore.save and MoodSlotEditDialog call this same validate, so validation rules have a single implementation across persistence and UI.

MoodSlotPolicy centralizes the tunable thresholds: POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD = 10 (small-pool warning), MATCH_MIN_RATIO = 0.35f (include gate: a slot word only counts a song as a hit when the word's fraction of the whole song is at least this; user manual tags count as 1.0 and always match), EXCLUDE_MIN_RATIO = EmotionGroup.MIN_RATIO (0.15f, exclude gate identical to the detail page's display threshold), NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 20 (name validation), and MAX_SLOTS = 10, which is a soft per-user limit not enforced by any code path.

TimeSlotConfigStore stores all slot configs as a single JSONArray under the key time_slot_configs in the mood_time_slot Preferences DataStore (no Room schema change); each serialized object carries id/name/start/end/tags plus an always-written excludedTags array. save validates via MoodSlotResolver first, merges by id, rewrites the whole key sorted by startMinutes, and throws IllegalArgumentException carrying either the SlotError name or the conflicting slot's name; delete rewrites the key without the matching entry.

TimeSlotConfigStore parsing is tolerant in three ways: an outer runCatching returns an empty list when the whole key is unreadable, an inner per-item runCatching skips a single corrupted entry with a "skip corrupted time slot config" warning while preserving the rest of the list, and excludedTags is read with JSON optJSONArray so configs persisted before the field existed parse as an empty exclusion list instead of failing the row.

Hilt wiring: DataStoreModule provides the mood_time_slot DataStore as a @TimeSlotConfigStore-qualified singleton, and RepositoryModule binds TimeSlotConfigStore both as a singleton and as the domain TimeSlotConfigRepository interface.

The anything-play enhancement is unified under the single RandomEnhanceMode enum (OFF / TIME_SLOT / EXPLORE, three mutually-exclusive states): PlayerSettingsRepository.randomEnhanceMode prefers the random_enhance_mode DataStore string key and falls back (legacy users) to the mood_time_slot_enabled boolean (true → TIME_SLOT, else OFF); moodTimeSlotEnabled is derived as randomEnhanceMode.map { it == TIME_SLOT }, setRandomEnhanceMode writes both keys in one edit, and PlayerRuntime wires the facade's moodSlotEnabled/exploreModeEnabled lambdas not to per-draw DataStore reads but to the @Volatile randomEnhanceModeCache (seeded once at startup in start() then kept fresh by observeMoodSlotCaches), giving zero-IO per-draw mode evaluation consistent with the UI's isExploreModeActive.

PlayerRuntime.observeMoodSlotCaches (started from start() after the startup sequence, deliberately low-frequency and non-blocking) continuously collects timeSlotConfigRepository.observeConfigs() into @Volatile moodSlotConfigsCache and songEmotionRepository.observeAll() — a Room invalidation stream mapped per song in a single pass into two @Volatile ratio maps (moodEmotionRatiosCache from emotionMatchRatiosOf for slot matching, exclusion and refill filtering; exploreVoteRatiosCache from emotionVoteRatiosOf for explore vote tallying) on flowOn(Default); it also collects wordPreferenceRepository.observeAll() into wordPreferenceCache and observes randomEnhanceMode into randomEnhanceModeCache / isExploreModeActive (leaving EXPLORE stops any explore session). Config saves/deletes and emotion analysis/calibration therefore take effect on the next random draw with no manual refresh and the facade reads these caches with zero DataStore IO.

MoodTimeSlotViewModel exposes configs, randomEnhanceMode, moodTimeSlotEnabled, and wordPreferences as stateIn(viewModelScope, WhileSubscribed(5_000)) StateFlows over the same repository flows the runtime observes (initial values cover only the first frame), so the config page and PlayerRuntime converge on any save, delete, or mode switch within one DataStore emission.

MoodTimeSlotViewModel.tagCounts and librarySize are deliberately non-streamed: loadStats() is a one-shot snapshot computed on Dispatchers.IO from a single songEmotionRepository.getAll() pass that yields both per-word song counts (via emotionTagsOf) and the per-song emotionMatchRatiosOf ratio table stored in a @Volatile emotionRatios field, plus songRepository.countSongs(); it is invoked per config-route entry by LaunchedEffect, clears poolStatsCache (and republishes counts and library size) when the ratio table is replaced, and on failure degrades tag counts to an empty list (badges show 0) without blocking configuration features.

PlayerRandomQueueFacade.activeMoodSlot() checks moodSlotEnabled(), resolves MoodSlotResolver.hitSlot at nowMinuteOfDay (an injectable lambda defaulting to Calendar), and caches the hit as MoodSlotState(slotName, tags, excludedTags); filterByMoodTags keeps a song when any (word, ratio) in moodEmotionTagRatiosOf(song) has word in mood.tags and ratio >= MATCH_MIN_RATIO (0.35), where manual-tag songs carry 1.0 and the default moodEmotionTagRatiosOf derives 1.0 from moodEmotionTagsOf for callers that don't inject ratios; an empty result returns null with a "fall back to full library after exclusions" log, and a pool below POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD logs a "will loop" warning while the filter still applies.

playRandomQueue computes val explore = exploreModeEnabled() and val mood = if (explore) null else activeMoodSlot(), so explore mode skips the mood filter entirely and plans with ExplorePlaybackPolicy.INITIAL_BATCH_SIZE (10 songs), while non-explore narrows candidates as baseSongs = filterOutExcludedMoodTags(current.songs, mood) followed by filterByMoodTags(baseSongs, mood) — an empty include pool degrades to the excluded-filtered library, never the raw library; refillInfinitePlayQueue applies the same two stages to the full library each draw and, when the strict mood pool yields nothing and is smaller than baseSongs, re-plans over baseSongs with history reset and logs the non-excluded-library fallback; startInfinitePlay does not mood-filter (the filter applies from the first refill) and is blocked entirely while an explore session is active (current.isExplorePlay).

Attribution: PlayerRuntime.playRandomQueue/onResult and startInfinitePlay/onResult run the suspend facade call, then re-evaluate randomQueueFacade.currentMoodSlot()?.slotName — the same activeMoodSlot() evaluation the filtering used — and invoke (started, moodSlotName) on the main thread; AppRoot's lucky-play entry bar toasts 已按「$slotName」为你随机播放 and NowPlayingSurface's infinite-start toasts 已按「$slotName」开启无限随机播放, both falling back to the import hint when nothing started, while the lucky-play wiring in HomeRouteActions keeps a generic toast without attribution.

Config UI data flow: AppNavHost's MOOD_TIME_SLOT route collects configs/randomEnhanceMode/wordPreferences/tagCounts/librarySize, calls loadStats() once per entry, refreshes nowMinuteOfDay on a 30-second loop, and passes poolCountOf = { tags, excludedTags -> matchCount(tags, excludedTags) } into MoodTimeSlotRouteState plus poolStatsOf = { tags, excludedTags -> poolStats(tags, excludedTags) } and availableTags = the observed tag names into MoodSlotEditDialog; the mode-selector card's onSelectMode calls moodTimeSlotViewModel.setMode and the NavHost toasts the resulting mode; the UserScreen entry card branches on RandomEnhanceMode — TIME_SLOT shows 生效中 with the covering slot's name only when a slot covers the current minute, EXPLORE shows 探索模式生效中, OFF shows disabled states — with save success/failure and delete toasts routed through the ViewModel.

MoodSlotEditDialog holds tags and excludedTags as separate local sets kept disjoint in the UI (selecting an include chip removes that word from the exclude set, and exclude chips come from availableTags.take(12) minus the included tags), validates locally while typing with save disabled on inline errors and runs the same MoodSlotResolver.validate on save, mapping every SlotError and Conflict to user-facing copy; times use a 24-hour system TimePicker with minutes-of-day storage; the three-layer pool preview (排除 X 首 · 情绪词条满足 Y 首 with 合计 Z / librarySize 首, a 35% include-threshold explainer, and "未选择包含词条：将在排除后的全库随机" when only exclusions are set) comes from the caller's poolStatsOf and is memoized with remember(tags, excludedTags) so typing the name never re-scans the library.

The config UI mirrors the runtime small-pool warning: configs2Items maps each slot to poolCountOf(config.tags, config.excludedTags) (the ViewModel's matchCount, i.e. MoodPoolStats.available) and a card shows 歌曲较少，将循环播放 when that number is below the UI-local MOOD_POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD = 10 (same value as MoodSlotPolicy.POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD); the card also renders the slot's excluded words as a 不包含 line, and the item list is memoized on state.configs and state.tagCounts outside LazyListScope so recomposition never redoes the per-slot full-library counts.

MoodSlotResolverTest locks the resolver contract: half-open boundary hits/misses, the full overnight window (22:00/23:41/00:00/05:59 hit; 06:00/21:59/noon miss), a per-minute sweep proving at most one hit for valid configs, deterministic earliest-start resolution on invalid multi-hit data, disabled-switch and empty-config inactivity, and every validation branch — including include-only and exclude-only configs being valid while both-empty returns NO_TAGS, EXCLUDED_TAG_OVERLAP for a word in both sets, the 20-character name boundary, touching endpoints, same-id edits without self-conflict, and ring-overlap symmetry.

PlayerRandomQueueFacadeTest locks the consumption floor: include-side narrowing to tagged songs, empty-pool fallback (log contains "fall back to full library"), inactivity outside the slot and with the switch off, uniform-random tiering composed with the mood filter (a 0-play song precedes a 10-play song inside the filtered pool), threshold gating (0.70 hits while 0.16 misses), and plain-OR fallback when no ratios are injected; the exclusion dimension is locked by tests where excluded tags remove songs from the pool, a 10% excluded word does not exclude while 27.4% does (detail-page parity), the empty include pool keeps excluded songs out and logs "fall back to full library after exclusions", infinite refill skips excluded tags, and refill degrades to the non-excluded library with unanalyzed songs still eligible.

Inclusion and exclusion deliberately use different gates: MATCH_MIN_RATIO = 0.35 (p25 of the whole-library ratio distribution, chosen because plain-OR matching left only about 30% confident songs in the 「emo 时刻」 pool while the 0.35 cut leaves a 40-song pool about 70% confident) versus EXCLUDE_MIN_RATIO = EmotionGroup.MIN_RATIO = 0.15 so exclusion honors exactly the words the song detail page displays, since a 0.35 exclude gate would still play a song the page labels 「躁」 at 27%; both filters read emotionMatchRatiosOf's full distribution (no display topN truncation), and exclusion runs before inclusion in the runtime filters and in pool statistics, so an empty include pool falls back to the excluded-filtered library instead of reintroducing excluded songs.

MoodPoolStats.from(ratiosBySong, tags, excludedTags, librarySize) counts each analyzed song once by iterating the per-song ratio map: excluded = songs with any excluded word at ratio >= EXCLUDE_MIN_RATIO, matched = non-excluded songs with any included word at ratio >= MATCH_MIN_RATIO, and available = (librarySize - excluded), so songs with no ratio row (unanalyzed) are neither excluded nor matched but remain eligible in available. Counting from the ratio map prevents multi-tag songs from being double-counted and makes the two counters disjoint, mirroring the runtime's exclusion-before-inclusion order.

MoodTimeSlotViewModel.poolStats(tags, excludedTags) caches MoodPoolStats in a synchronized HashMap keyed by Triple(includedTags, excludedTags, librarySize), because pool statistics are a full-library scan invoked at composition time (once per slot card, and in the edit dialog on tag changes); matchCount(tags, excludedTags) returns poolStats(...).available, and loadStats() clears the cache whenever it replaces the per-song ratio table so counts can never outlive the data they were derived from.

filterOutExcludedMoodTags is the exclusion stage: it returns the input list untouched when the slot has no excludedTags, otherwise drops every song whose ratio map contains an excluded word at ratio >= EXCLUDE_MIN_RATIO (0.15) and logs "moodSlot: excluded N songs by tags=…"; it runs before filterByMoodTags in both playRandomQueue and refillInfinitePlayQueue, so include-side matching and refill planning only ever see non-excluded songs.
